manifest_generation_python:
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
c=Path.cwd(); h=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); req=json.loads((c/'.omc/visual-requirement.json').read_text()); policy_pin=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(req['policy'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(); out=c/'.omc/standalone-final'; b=c/'apps/store-manager/public/omc-ad-pixels/bundle.js'
for d in [1,2]:
 m={'schema_version':'omc-visual-manifest/v1','url':'http://localhost:@PORT@/omc-ad-pixels/index.html','bundle_url':'http://localhost:@PORT@/omc-ad-pixels/bundle.js','bundle_path':str(b.relative_to(c)),'bundle_sha256':h(b),'build_inputs':req['policy']['builder_inputs'],'dpr':d,'images_per_variant':2,'run_id':req['run_id'],'policy_sha256':policy_pin}; p=out/f'manifest-{d}.json'; p.write_text(json.dumps(m,indent=2)); print(d,h(p))
